notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Patch 1.02
Updated the UI with more sounds 
Updated the look of the UI
You can now play the whole game only using the mouse. 
Ramify now launches in full screen but can be changed to windowed in the options.
Steamcloud has been added but not on the storepage. New games it functions with but not  already installed. Still a work in progress. 


After testing on different PC configurations we have lowered the min requirements on the steam storepage.  

Hope everyone enjoys the update!
Daniel
